description_target.target_text: The left panel provides a reference object, highlighted in red(2). Its feature triple is transferred across the separator into the right panel, where the matching candidate is extracted, cropped, and recolored to cyan(8).

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; Two panels split by a full gray(5) column. The LEFT panel's red(2)
 ;; object defines a feature TRIPLE — (area, enclosed-hole count, symmetry
 ;; class: 0 none / 1 up-down / 2 left-right / 3 both). Output the first
 ;; (top-left order) RIGHT-panel object with the same triple, as its
 ;; cropped shape mask painted cyan(8).
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (norm-cells obj)
       (let ((bb (obj-bbox obj)))
         (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (first bb))
                                (- (second p) (second bb))))
              (obj-cells obj))))
     (define (mask-of obj color)
       (paint-cells (empty-grid (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj) 0)
                    (norm-cells obj) color))
     (define (holes-of obj)
       ;; enclosed 0-regions of the shape mask (none touching its border)
       (let ((mask (mask-of obj 1)))
         (length (filter (lambda (region)
                           (all? (lambda (p)
                                   (and (> (first p) 0)
                                        (< (first p) (- (rows mask) 1))
                                        (> (second p) 0)
                                        (< (second p) (- (cols mask) 1))))
                                 region))
                         (find-0-regions mask 0)))))
     (define (sym-class obj)
       (let ((cells (norm-cells obj)))
         (+ (if (all? (lambda (p) (member (list (- (obj-h obj) 1 (first p))
                                               (second p))
                                         cells))
                      cells)
                1 0)
            (if (all? (lambda (p) (member (list (first p)
                                               (- (obj-w obj) 1 (second p)))
                                         cells))
                      cells)
                2 0))))
     (define (triple obj)
       (list (obj-size obj) (holes-of obj) (sym-class obj)))
     (define seps
       (filter (lambda (c) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 5))
                                 (range 0 (rows g))))
               (range 0 (cols g))))
     (define ref (subgrid g 0 0 (- (rows g) 1) (- (first seps) 1)))
     (define cand
       (subgrid g 0 (+ (first seps) 1) (- (rows g) 1)
                (if (> (length seps) 1)
                    (- (second seps) 1)
                    (- (cols g) 1))))
     (define target-feat
       (triple (first (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 2))
                              (objects ref 0)))))
     (define target
       (first (filter (lambda (o) (equal? (triple o) target-feat))
                      (sort (objects cand 0)
                            (lambda (a b)
                              (let ((ba (obj-bbox a)) (bb (obj-bbox b)))
                                (or (< (first ba) (first bb))
                                    (and (= (first ba) (first bb))
                                         (< (second ba) (second bb))))))))))
     (mask-of target 8))))
